title_ja: Phone makers ditched 3.5mm for USB-C, but which one offers better audio quality?
summary_ja: There's a lot more to it than just the port.For years, the 3.5mm headphone jack was an expected, default feature on every iPhone or Android device.This tiny, round descendant of the 6.35mm "phone plug" carries a converted analog audio signal from the phone to the preferred listening device.Its simplicity is rivaled only by its universal acceptance, and it remains a staple feature in many devices.
